Agreement with formulas that are algebraic functionals of that empirical distribution is consequently close to an in-sample consistency check, with no held-out evaluation or uncertainty analysis for the crucial lower-left ROC tail.

The variable-threshold aggregate method uses oracle query difficulty—whether the generator is correct at least 1% of the time—which requires ground-truth labels and repeated samples. This limits its deployability, while GPQA and HumanEval+ improvements largely fall within the reported confidence intervals.

Reproducibility is incomplete: no code or generated-output artifact is supplied, several decoding and sampling details are underspecified, and the acknowledged seed error makes the individual-query and aggregate protocols inconsistent.

Some existential constructions used for the non-extrapolability and converse results introduce an independent random variable by augmenting the response space, despite the formal setup defining a deterministic verifier on a fixed response space. The statements should explicitly permit randomized verifiers or assume a sufficiently rich/atomless space.

The suggested connection to reinforcement learning applies only to an unconstrained distributional optimization with deterministic binary reward; its implications for parameterized LLM training are substantially more limited than the discussion suggests.
